subject.title: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board

text: I believe that strong public schools are key to preserving democracy and opportunity. As a parent activist and as a School Board member, I have been deeply committed to excellence and equity and to ensuring that all children graduate from high school prepared for success in an ever-changing world. I have used my experience in our diverse district and my legal and policy-making expertise to help make our great schools even greater by:
- Promoting high-quality Transitional Kindergarten/early childhood programs that prepare students for kindergarten;
- Supporting students with engaging and rigorous curriculum that teaches critical thinking skills;
- Ensuring strong teaching and necessary interventions that help all students attain academic mastery and address the achievement/opportunity gap;
- Evaluating and navigating the appropriate role for technology in our schools;
- Maintaining and modernizing schools to ensure staff and student safety and access to facilities that support 21st century learning;
- Enhancing our revered music and fine arts programs;
- Balancing our budget, strengthening our financial reserves, and maintaining our strong credit rating.
I am supported by:

Community for Excellent Public Schools
Congressmember Ted Lieu
Senator Ben Allen
Assemblymember Rick Zbur
All current School Board members
I would be honored to earn your support too.
www.lieberman4schoolboard.com

text: Occupation: Executive/Education Advocate

I am an 18-year Santa Monica resident, tech partnerships executive, education non-profit board member, and father of a first grader and a toddler. I am running for School Board to ensure our public schools deliver the excellence, safety, and support every child and teacher deserves.

While our board brings valuable long-standing tenure, it lacks representation from current district parents who experience our schools daily. As an active parent invested in our district's future for the next decade and beyond, my background in organizational leadership, budget oversight, and education non-profits directly complements the existing board's strengths, bringing fresh operational rigor to achieve our shared goals.
My priorities address SMMUSD families' real, immediate needs:
Expand care and enrichment programs for all families.
Deliver strong STEM education paired with a responsible policy limiting screen time, restricting classroom AI,
and prioritizing human connections.
Expand healthy outdoor spaces and promote environmental stewardship.
Protect students walking and biking to school.
I am running to deliver substantive, progressive solutions that support our teachers and help our kids thrive. I humbly ask for your vote.
https://leshnerforsmmusd.com

text: Age: 30
Occupation: Legislative Advisor to California State Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur
I'm Robbie Staenberg—a former teacher and graduate of SMMUSD schools, and I would be honored to have your vote.
I grew up in Santa Monica and attended our K-12 public schools. (Proud Samohi graduate!)

After graduating from Columbia University, I spent 2018-2023 teaching social studies at a Title 1 high school in Oakland, where more than 90% of students qualified for free or reduced lunch. The inequity I encountered transformed my understanding of educational policy and politics.

I came home and began working for Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur, who represents Santa Monica in the California State Legislature. I spend my days working on legislation and policy, engaging with various constituent groups, and deepening my understanding of state policy and its impacts.
If elected, I will be the only Board member who has worked as a full-time teacher and the only Board member who has attended our SMMUSD public schools.

I am committed to:
- Expanding access to early childhood education and after-school programs
- Ensuring engagement, collaboration, and transparency with our community
- Closing outcome gaps and guaranteeing academic excellence for all students

I am supported by:
- Six Current Santa Monica-Malibu School Board Members
- Santa Monica's Mayor and all City Council Members
- Members of SMC's Board of Trustees and Rent Control Board
- Community for Excellence Public Schools
I hope to earn your support as well!
www.robbiestaenberg.com

text: Age: 56
I'm a 24-year Malibu resident and parent of 2 adult kids who attended Malibu Public Schools from K-l2th grade. I currently serve as a Board Member for SM-MUSD.

I have worked throughout my career to bring people together, empower the agency of individuals, and improve and change established systems to better fit the people they serve. I did that as PTA president, Malibu Schools Leadership Council President, and have continued that work the last four years serving on the school board.

Throughout that 13 years of service, there have been many times of instability - natural disasters including three major fires, disputes and tension between our two cities, contention within each community, leadership changes, the pandemic - that confused, angered, and frightened the community. I found my footing by listening and trying to effectively communicate the needs of people involved.

I've participated in bringing connection and collaboration to our cities and to my work on the board. By engaging groups and people in our communities, listening to needs and perspectives, and addressing issues together, we can move forward even when we disagree.
I hope to continue my work for the Malibu community, and SM-MUSD students, families and staff.
vote4stacyrouse.org

text: Age: 39
Occupation: School Board President
I'm Alicia Mignano, President of the Santa Monica–Malibu School Board. I was elected in 2022, and I'm excited to ask for your vote for reelection.

I'm a renter in the Pico neighborhood with my husband and our son, who started sixth grade at JAMS in August. As an immigrant from Mexico, I learned English and gained the skills to build a career and contribute to my community, all through public education. I serve because I know what education can do for a child, no matter what walk of life they come from.

Over the last four years, I've worked to put students first. During my first two months on the Board, I visited every school in Santa Monica and Malibu to better understand the diverse needs of our students and teachers. I've focused on improving outcomes for multilingual learners, protecting early reading intervention teachers from budget cuts, supporting healthier classrooms through upgraded air filtration across the district, and investing in long-overdue deferred maintenance. While I'm proud of what we've accomplished, there's still important work ahead to keep our schools strong.
I would be honored to earn your vote.
